newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libyan army chief sees stronger ties with Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: Libyan army chief sees stronger ties with Tunisia.

text.p: The Libyan army's acting chief, Colonel Abu Bakr Jaber Yunes, on Tuesday said economic cooperation between Tunisia and Libya was expected to be boosted during the next few months.

"Visits will intensify during the coming days to implement previous agreements aiming at complementarity in different sectors between the two countries," Yunes told reporters after a meeting with Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali.
"The next months will see a greater boost for economic change (in relations) between Tunisia and Libya," he added.
Yunes, coordinator of the three-man General Provisional Committee which heads the Libyan army, arrived in Tunis on Monday.
He also held talks with Tunisian Defence Minister Habib Ben Yahia, Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari, and Interior Minister Mohamed Ben Rejeb.
